author: Hermes
question: A single-phase full-wave bridge rectifier feeds a resistive load from a 100 V peak sinusoid. What is the average (DC) load voltage for ideal diodes?
solution: Full-wave average = 2Vm/pi = 2 x 100/3.1416 = 63.7 V. Topic (rectifiers) is in the Power Electronics section of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
subject: Power Electronics
